capabilities: Create mindmaps from Markdown heading structure or scratch
Bind nodes to notes, images and Excalidraw files with zoomed-in previews
Navigate large maps via semantic zoom, minimap, search and keyboard shortcuts
Generate a local knowledge map from a file's backlinks and outlinks
Edit trees with mirror/right/free layouts, undo/redo and autosave
disambiguation: Not a freeform whiteboard like Obsidian Canvas; it renders tree-structured mindmaps saved as .naotu files.
extras: SVG/PNG export is listed on the roadmap and still in development; the plugin installs on mobile but is optimized for desktop. README states it makes no network requests and stores data as .naotu files in the vault; further docs referenced in DEVELOPMENT.md.
problem: Obsidian has no zoomable mindmap where zoom changes information granularity and tree nodes can embed and preview vault content like notes and images.

relations.evidence: Excalidraw Nodes - Nodes bound to image or Excalidraw files, showing embedded preview when zoomed in

summary: Semantic-zoom mindmap canvas whose text, note, image and Excalidraw nodes reveal more content as you zoom in.
